answer_en: Malaria is common in Uganda and can become severe quickly. Common symptoms include fever, chills, headache, weakness and sometimes vomiting. Testing is important before treatment when possible. If malaria is confirmed, take the treatment prescribed by a health worker and complete it. Seek urgent care for confusion, seizures, difficulty breathing, repeated vomiting, severe weakness or unconsciousness, especially in a young child or pregnant woman. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Omusujja gw'ensiri gubuna mu Uganda era guyinza okufuuka omuzibu amangu. Obubonero buyinza okuba omusujja, okukankana, omutwe oguluma, obunafu n'okusesema. Kigezesebwe nga kisoboka nga tonnatandika ddagala. Bw'okakasibwa, nywa eddagala omusawo ly'akuwadde era olimalirize. Genda mangu mu ddwaliro singa obeera n'okutabulwa, ensimbu, okussa obubi, okusesema ennyo oba okuzirika. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Pregnancy needs regular antenatal care. At visits, health workers check the mother and baby, screen for important conditions and provide preventive care. Uganda's current maternal guidance promotes early antenatal care and a minimum of eight contacts for an uncomplicated pregnancy. Seek urgent care for heavy vaginal bleeding, severe headache or visual problems, convulsions, severe abdominal pain, difficulty breathing, fever, or reduced or absent fetal movement. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Olubuto lwetaaga okugendanga mu bujjanjabi obw'olubuto buli kiseera. Abasawo bakebera maama n'omwana, ne babasikiriza endwadde ez'enjawulo era ne babawa obukuumi obwetaagisa. Mu Uganda, obulagirizi obw'obudde obuliwo bukubiriza okutandika ANC nga bukyali n'okuba n'okukwatagana n'abasawo emirundi egisinga omunaana mu lubuto olutali lwa buzibu. Genda mangu mu ddwaliro singa wabaawo musaayi mungi, omutwe ogw'amaanyi n'okutalaba bulungi, ensimbu, obulumi obw'amaanyi mu lubuto, okussa obubi, omusujja oba omwana okulekera awo okutambula. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Vaccines protect children and adults from serious infections. Children should receive vaccines according to Uganda's current national immunization schedule. Keep the child's health card and ask a health facility about any missed dose rather than restarting vaccines yourself. Vaccination services are provided through government and other authorized health facilities. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Obugema bukuma abaana n'abakulu okuva ku ndwadde ez'obulabe. Abaana balina okugemebwa nga bagoberera enteekateeka y'obugema ey'e Uganda eriwo. Kuuma kaadi y'obulamu bw'omwana era buuza ku ddwaliro ku kugema kwonna okwabuuka; togoberera wekka nga tonnabuuzanga musawo. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Tuberculosis commonly affects the lungs but can affect other parts of the body. A cough lasting two weeks or more, weight loss, fever or night sweats should be assessed at a health facility. TB is curable when diagnosed and treated correctly. Do not stop TB medicines early, and follow the health worker's treatment and follow-up instructions. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: TB etera okukwata amawuggwe naye eyinza okukwata ebitundu ebirala eby'omubiri. Okukolola okumala wiiki bbiri oba okusingawo, okukendeera obuzito, omusujja oba okutukuta ekiro birina okwekebejjebwa ku ddwaliro. TB ewonyezebwa singa ekakasibwa nejjanjabibwa bulungi. Tokomya ddagala lya TB nga tonnaggwa. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: HIV is a manageable chronic infection when diagnosed early and treated consistently. HIV testing is the only way to know your status. People living with HIV can stay healthy on antiretroviral treatment and should take it exactly as prescribed. Use condoms where appropriate, avoid sharing needles, and seek professional advice about pregnancy and preventing transmission to a baby. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: HIV ndwadde eyinza okuddukanyizibwa obulungi singa ekwatibwa nga bukyali era eddagala ne linywebwa bulijjo. Okwekebeza HIV kwe kusinga okumanya obutakanya bwo. Abantu abalina HIV bayinza okubeera balamu bulungi nga banywa eddagala lya ARV nga bwe balagiddwa. Kozesa kondomu we kyetaagisa, togabana mpiso, era buuza abasawo ku by'obutaddira mwana HIV. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Pneumonia is an infection of the lungs. It may cause cough, fever, fast or difficult breathing, chest pain and weakness. Young children, older adults and people with other illnesses can become seriously ill. Seek urgent care for difficulty breathing, blue or grey lips, confusion, severe weakness, or a child who is unable to drink or breastfeed. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Pneumonia bulwadde bwa mawuggwe. Buyinza okuleeta okukolola, omusujja, okussa amangu oba obuzibu mu kussa, obulumi mu kifuba n'obunafu. Abaana abato n'abakadde bayinza okufuna obuzibu obw'amaanyi. Genda mangu mu ddwaliro singa okussa kuba kuzibu, emimwa ne gifuuka gya bbululu, oba omuntu atandika okutabulwa. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Diarrhea can cause dangerous dehydration, especially in young children. Give frequent fluids and oral rehydration solution when available, continue breastfeeding and feeding as appropriate, and seek medical advice if it is severe or persistent. Urgent signs include inability to drink, repeated vomiting, very little urine, unusual sleepiness, blood in stool or severe weakness. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Okutabaala kuyinza okuleeta okukala amazzi mu mubiri, naddala mu baana abato. Wa amazzi oba ORS emirundi mingi nga bwe kisoboka, era genda mu maaso n'okuyonsa n'okuliisa omwana. Genda mangu mu ddwaliro singa omuntu tasobola kunywa, asesema buli kaseera, takola mwoyo mungi, abeera mugonvu nnyo, oba aba n'omusaayi mu kasooli. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Cholera can cause sudden, severe watery diarrhea and dehydration. During an outbreak, use safe treated water, wash hands with soap, use toilets safely and avoid unsafe food and water. A person with sudden profuse watery diarrhea needs urgent assessment and rehydration at a health facility. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Kolera eyinza okuleeta okutabaala okw'amazzi amangi n'okukala amazzi mu mubiri amangu. Mu kiseera ky'okubalukawo kw'endwadde, kozesa amazzi amayonjo era agalamiddwa, naaba engalo n'omusaaba, kozesa kaabuyonjo bulungi era weewale emmere n'amazzi agatali malongoofu. Omuntu atandika okutabaala okw'amazzi amangi alina okugenda mangu mu ddwaliro. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Typhoid is a bacterial infection usually spread through contaminated food or water. Fever that persists, headache, weakness, abdominal discomfort or diarrhea or constipation should be assessed by a health worker. Testing may be needed. Do not use leftover antibiotics because the correct treatment depends on assessment and local resistance patterns. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Typhoid ndwadde ya bacteria etera okutambulira mu mmere oba amazzi ebiyonoonefu. Omusujja ogutawera, omutwe oguluma, obunafu, obulumi mu lubuto oba okutabaala birina okwekebejjebwa. Buulira omusawo obubonero bwo era weewale okukozesa obuwuzi bwa antibiotics obwasigalawo nga tonnabuuzanga. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: A common cold usually causes a runny or blocked nose, sneezing, sore throat and cough and often improves with time. Rest, fluids and appropriate comfort measures can help. Seek care if symptoms are severe, last unusually long, or there is difficulty breathing, chest pain, confusion or persistent high fever. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Obusujja obwa bulijjo buyinza okuleeta amazzi mu nnyindo, okuzibikira, okukwasa, obulumi mu mumiro n'okukolola. Okwemalirira n'okunywa amazzi biyamba. Genda ku musawo singa obubonero buba bwa maanyi, bumala ebbanga ddene, oba okussa kuba kuzibu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Asthma can cause episodes of wheezing, cough, chest tightness and shortness of breath. Triggers can include smoke, dust, infections and other exposures. Use prescribed inhalers according to the health worker's instructions. Severe breathing difficulty, inability to speak normally, blue lips or rapidly worsening symptoms require emergency care. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Asima eyinza okuleeta okuwuuuma mu kifuba, okukolola, okukakana mu kifuba n'okussa obubi. Omukka gw'emmotoka, enfuufu n'endwadde biyinza okugikuba. Kozesa inhaler omusawo gy'akuwadde nga bwe yakulagira. Singa okussa kuba kuzibu nnyo oba emimwa gifuuka gya bbululu, genda mangu mu ddwaliro. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: High blood pressure often has no symptoms, so checking it is important. Long-term uncontrolled blood pressure increases the risk of stroke, heart disease and kidney disease. Take prescribed medicines consistently, reduce excess salt, avoid tobacco, be physically active and attend follow-up. Very high blood pressure with severe headache, weakness on one side, chest pain, confusion or vision problems needs urgent care. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Omusaayi ogw'amaanyi emirundi mingi tegulaga bubonero, kyova weetaaga okugupima. Singa tegufugibwa guyinza okwongera obulabe bwa stroke, endwadde z'omutima n'ensigo. Nywa eddagala lyawe nga bwe walagirwa, kendeeza omunnyo mungi, weewale taaba era okole emizannyo. Obulumi mu kifuba, okutabulwa oba obunafu ku ludda lumu byetaaga obujjanjabi obw'amangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Diabetes causes high blood sugar and can damage the eyes, kidneys, nerves, heart and blood vessels when poorly controlled. Common symptoms include frequent urination, increased thirst, hunger, tiredness and unexplained weight loss. Testing is needed for diagnosis. Follow the treatment plan, eat a balanced diet, stay active and attend regular checks. Severe weakness, vomiting, confusion or unconsciousness is an emergency. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Diabetes ereeta sukaali mungi mu musaayi era singa tafugibwa bulungi eyinza okwonoona amaaso, ensigo, obusimu, omutima n'emisuwa. Obubonero buyinza okuba okunywa amazzi ennyo, okukuba omusulo emirundi mingi, enjala n'obunafu. Kebeza sukaali mu musaayi ku ddwaliro. Goberera obujjanjabi bw'omusawo, lya mmere ennungi era kola emirimu gy'omubiri. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Anemia means the blood does not carry enough oxygen, often because of iron deficiency, blood loss, infection or another condition. It can cause tiredness, weakness, dizziness, headaches and pale skin. The cause should be assessed rather than taking iron blindly. Heavy bleeding, fainting, severe shortness of breath or chest pain needs urgent care. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Obutaba na musaayi gumala kitegeeza nti omubiri tegufuna oxygen emala. Kuyinza okuva ku butaba na kyuma, okufiirwa omusaayi, endwadde oba ensonga endala. Obubonero buyinza okuba obunafu, okukoowa, okuzungera n'obutwe. Weetaaga okwekebejjebwa okumanya ensonga. Okufiirwa omusaayi mungi oba okuzirika kyetaaga obujjanjabi obw'amangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Sickle cell disease is an inherited blood condition. It can cause anemia, episodes of severe pain, infections and other complications. People with sickle cell disease should attend regular care and follow their prescribed prevention and treatment plan. Fever, severe pain, breathing difficulty, severe weakness, unusual sleepiness or other sudden deterioration needs urgent medical assessment. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Sickle cell bulwadde bw'omusaayi obusikirwa okuva ku bazadde. Buyinza okuleeta obutaba na musaayi gumala, obulumi obw'amaanyi n'endwadde ez'enjawulo. Omuntu alina sickle cell alina okugendanga mu bujjanjabi n'okugoberera enteekateeka y'omusawo. Omusujja, obulumi obw'amaanyi oba okussa obubi byetaaga obujjanjabi obw'amangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: A urinary tract infection can cause burning or pain when urinating, frequent urination, urgency or lower abdominal discomfort. A health worker may need to test the urine and decide whether antibiotics are appropriate. Fever, chills, vomiting or pain in the side or back can suggest a more serious kidney infection and needs prompt care. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Obulwadde bw'obusulo buyinza okuleeta okukomba nga okuba omusulo, okuba omusulo emirundi mingi oba obulumi wansi mu lubuto. Omusawo ayinza okukebejja omusulo n'alonda obujjanjabi obutuufu. Omusujja, okukankana, okusesema oba obulumi mu mugongo oba ku ludda byetaaga okwekebejjebwa mangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Sexually transmitted infections can cause discharge, sores, pain when urinating, pelvic pain or no symptoms at all. Testing is important because symptoms alone may not identify the infection. Avoid sex or use condoms as advised until assessed and treated. Partners may also need testing and treatment. Do not share antibiotics or use leftover medicine. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Endwadde ez'obukaba ziyinza okuleeta amazzi agava mu bitundu by'ekyama, amabwa, okukomba nga okuba omusulo oba obulumi mu lubuto, naye oluusi teziraga bubonero. Okwekebeza kikulu. Weewale okwegatta oba kozesa kondomu nga bwe balagidde okutuusa nga okebeddwa era ojanjabiddwa. Omuntu gw'ogabana naye naye ayinza okwetaaga okukeberebwa. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Hepatitis B is a viral infection of the liver and can become chronic. Some people have no symptoms; others develop tiredness, nausea, abdominal discomfort or yellow eyes and skin. Testing is needed to know your status. Vaccination prevents hepatitis B. Avoid sharing razors or needles and use safer sex practices. Pregnant women should be screened so appropriate prevention can be provided to the baby. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Hepatitis B ndwadde ya virus ekwata ekibumba era eyinza okumala ebbanga ddene. Abamu tebaba na bubonero; abalala baba n'obukoowu, okusesema oba amaaso n'olususu okufuuka byenvu. Okwekebeza kwe kumanya obutakanya. Obugema buyamba okuziyiza Hepatitis B. Weewale okugabana obwambe oba empiso era kozesa enkola ez'okwegatta ez'obukuumi. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Hepatitis C is a viral infection that can damage the liver and may cause few symptoms for years. Testing is needed to know whether someone has the infection. Modern treatment can cure many people. Avoid sharing needles or equipment contaminated with blood and use safe medical and sexual practices. Anyone with a positive test should be linked to qualified care. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Hepatitis C ndwadde ya virus eyinza okwonoona ekibumba era oluusi n'emala emyaka nga tewali bubonero bweyoleka. Okwekebeza kwe kumanya obutakanya. Abantu bangi bayinza okuwonyezebwa n'obujjanjabi obuliwo. Weewale okugabana empiso oba ebintu ebiyinza okuba n'omusaayi. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Stomach ulcers can cause burning or aching pain in the upper abdomen and may be related to Helicobacter pylori infection or certain pain medicines. Persistent symptoms should be assessed rather than self-treating for long periods. Vomiting blood, black stools, fainting or sudden severe abdominal pain requires emergency care. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Ekiwundu mu lubuto kiyinza okuleeta okwaka oba obulumi waggulu mu lubuto. Kiyinza okukwatagana ne Helicobacter pylori oba eddagala ly'obulumi erimu. Singa obulumi bumala, genda ku musawo okebejjebwe. Okusesema omusaayi, kasooli omuddugavu nnyo, okuzirika oba obulumi obw'amangu obw'amaanyi byetaaga obujjanjabi obw'amangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Acid reflux can cause a burning feeling behind the breastbone, sour taste or food coming back into the mouth, especially after meals or when lying down. Smaller meals, avoiding personal triggers and not lying down immediately after eating may help. Frequent symptoms should be assessed by a health worker, especially if there is difficulty swallowing, weight loss, bleeding or persistent vomiting. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Omubisi gw'olubuto okudda waggulu guyinza okuleeta okwaka mu kifuba, akamwa okuba n'obusungu oba emmere okudda mu kamwa. Weewale ebikuleetera obubonero era togalamira mangu ng'omalirizza okulya. Singa obubonero buba buli kiseera, genda ku musawo, naddala singa olina obuzibu mu kumira oba ofiirwa obuzito. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Constipation means stools are difficult or infrequent to pass. Drinking enough fluids, eating fiber-rich foods and staying physically active can help many people. Do not repeatedly use laxatives without advice. Severe abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, a swollen abdomen or inability to pass stool and gas needs medical assessment. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Okukalirira kasooli kitegeeza okufuna obuzibu mu kugenda mu kaabuyonjo. Okunywa amazzi agamala, okulya emmere erimu fiber n'okukola emirimu gy'omubiri biyamba abantu bangi. Obulumi obw'amaanyi mu lubuto, okusesema emirundi mingi oba olubuto okuvimba byetaaga okwekebejjebwa. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Intestinal worms can cause abdominal discomfort, poor nutrition, anemia or weakness, although some people have no symptoms. Prevention includes handwashing, safe sanitation, wearing shoes where appropriate and eating safe food. Deworming programs may be recommended for children and other groups according to local public-health guidance. Ask a health worker which treatment is appropriate. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Obuwuka mu lubuto buyinza okuleeta obulumi mu lubuto, obutaba na mmere emala, obutaba na musaayi gumala oba obunafu, naye abamu tebaba na bubonero. Naaba engalo, kozesa kaabuyonjo, lya emmere enyonjo era yambala engatto. Buulira omusawo ku ngeri y'okugema obuwuka n'eddagala erisaanira. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Schistosomiasis, also called bilharzia, is acquired through contact with freshwater where infected parasites are present. It can affect the intestines or urinary system. Avoid swimming or bathing in unsafe freshwater in affected areas and use safe sanitation. Blood in urine or stool, abdominal symptoms or other persistent symptoms after freshwater exposure should be assessed at a health facility. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Bilharzia, oba schistosomiasis, eyinza okukwatibwa omuntu bw'abeera mu mazzi ag'obutonde agalimu obuwuka obwo. Eyinza okukwata olubuto oba obusulo. Weewale okunaaba oba okuwugira mu mazzi agatali makakafu mu bifo ebirimu endwadde. Omusaayi mu musulo oba kasooli gwenna guleeta obwetaavu bw'okwekebejjebwa. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Skin problems have many causes, including infections, allergies and irritation. Keep affected skin clean and avoid squeezing boils or sharing towels, razors or clothing. A spreading rash, severe pain, pus, fever, rapidly increasing swelling or involvement around the eyes needs medical assessment. Children and people with diabetes may need earlier care. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Endwadde z'olususu zisobola okuva ku buwuka, allergy oba okukwatibwa ebintu ebiruma olususu. Kuuma olususu nga luyonjo era tokanda mababwa. Weewale okugabana towels, byambalo oba ebyuma by'okumwa. Amabwa agasaasaana, amasannyalaze, omusujja oba okuvimba okw'amangu byetaaga omusawo. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Scabies is caused by tiny mites and commonly causes intense itching, often worse at night, with small bumps or a rash. It spreads through close contact and sometimes shared bedding or clothing. Treatment should be obtained from a health worker or pharmacist according to local guidance, and close contacts may also need treatment. Wash bedding and clothing appropriately. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Scabies eva ku buwuka obutonotono era etera okuleeta okwekuba ennyo, naddala ekiro, n'obutimba ku lususu. Esaasaana nga abantu bali kumpi. Genda ku musawo oba omukugu w'eddagala okufuna obujjanjabi obutuufu, era abantu abali kumpi naawe bayinza okwetaaga obujjanjabi. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Conjunctivitis can cause red or irritated eyes, watering and discharge. Some causes are infectious and can spread easily. Wash hands, avoid touching the eyes and do not share towels. Severe eye pain, sensitivity to light, reduced vision, injury or a chemical splash requires urgent eye care. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Obulwadde bw'amaaso buyinza okuleeta amaaso okufuuka ammyufu, amazzi oba obusa. Obumu busobola okusaasaana. Naaba engalo, tokuba mu maaso era togabana towels. Obulumi obw'amaanyi mu liiso, obutalaba bulungi, okukosebwa oba eddagala okutuuka mu liiso byetaaga obujjanjabi obw'amangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: A cataract is clouding of the eye's lens and can gradually reduce vision. It is common with ageing but can have other causes. A proper eye examination is needed. Cataracts can often be treated effectively with surgery when they significantly affect vision. Sudden loss of vision is not typical of a simple cataract and needs urgent assessment. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Cataract kwe kuzikira kw'ekitundu ekiri mu liiso ekuyamba okutunuulira. Kiyinza okukendeeza okulaba mpola mpola. Okwekebejjebwa kw'amaaso kwe kusinga okumanya ensonga. Cataract esobola okujjanjabibwa n'okulongoosa liiso singa okulaba kukendedde nnyo. Okutalaba mangu kyetaaga obujjanjabi obw'amangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Glaucoma can damage the optic nerve and may cause permanent vision loss. It can progress without obvious symptoms, so regular eye checks are important, especially for people at higher risk. Treatment can slow or control damage but lost vision may not return. Sudden severe eye pain with headache, vomiting or blurred vision needs emergency eye care. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Glaucoma esobola okwonoona obusimu bw'eriiso n'okuleeta okutalaba okw'olubeerera. Oluusi etambula nga tewali bubonero, kyova weetaaga okwekebejjebwa amaaso. Okulaba okuggwa mangu nga waliwo obulumi obw'amaanyi mu liiso n'okusesema kyetaaga obujjanjabi obw'amangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Tooth decay can cause toothache, sensitivity and eventually infection. Brush teeth twice daily with fluoride toothpaste, limit frequent sugary foods and drinks, and have regular dental checks. Facial swelling, fever, difficulty swallowing or difficulty breathing with dental pain requires urgent care. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Okuboloka kw'amannyo kuyinza okuleeta obulumi n'okukwatibwa ennyo. Oyoza amannyo emirundi ebiri buli lunaku n'ekikozesebwa ekirimu fluoride, kendeeza ku sukaali era genda mu kukebera amannyo. Okuvimba mu maaso, omusujja oba obuzibu mu kumira oba kussa byetaaga obujjanjabi obw'amangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Mental health problems can affect mood, sleep, thoughts, relationships and daily activities. Anxiety, persistent sadness, loss of interest, severe stress and panic can be treated and supported. Talk to a trusted person and seek professional help if symptoms persist or interfere with daily life. Thoughts of suicide, self-harm, severe confusion or inability to stay safe require immediate emergency help. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Obulamu bw'obwongo bukwata ku ndowooza, enneewulira, otulo n'engeri gy'okolamu emirimu. Okweraliikirira, ennaku ezimala, obutaba na ssanyu n'okutya ennyo bisobola okujjanjabibwa. Yogera n'omuntu gw'wesiga era funa obuyambi bw'omukugu. Ebirowoozo by'okwekomya oba obutabeera bulungi byetaaga obuyambi obw'amangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Epilepsy is a condition in which a person has recurrent unprovoked seizures. During a seizure, protect the person from injury, place them on their side if possible, clear nearby objects and do not put anything in their mouth. Do not restrain them. A first seizure, a seizure lasting about five minutes or more, repeated seizures without recovery, injury or breathing problems needs emergency care. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Ensimbu ziva ku buzibu bw'obusimu bw'obwongo obuleeta okukwatibwa emirundi egiddamu. Nga omuntu akwatiddwa ensimbu, mukume okuva ku bikoloboze, mumuteeke ku ludda singa kisoboka era tomuteekamu kintu mu kamwa. Toba mukaka. Ensimbu eyasooka, emala eddakiika nga ttaano oba okusingawo, eziddamu nga tamala kuda, oba okussa obubi byetaaga obujjanjabi obw'amangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Stroke happens when blood flow to part of the brain is blocked or a blood vessel bleeds. Warning signs can include sudden weakness or numbness on one side, facial drooping, difficulty speaking, sudden vision problems, severe headache or loss of balance. Treat it as an emergency and seek medical care immediately. Do not wait for symptoms to improve. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Stroke etera okubaawo ng'omusaayi gutatuuka bulungi mu kitundu ky'obwongo oba omusuwa gw'omusaayi negwabika. Obubonero obw'amangu buyinza okuba oludda lumu olw'omubiri okunafuwa, akamwa okugwa ku ludda, okwogera obubi, okutalaba bulungi oba omutwe okuluma ennyo. Genda mangu mu ddwaliro; togenda kulinda bubonero kumala. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: A heart attack is an emergency. Possible symptoms include pressure or pain in the chest, pain spreading to the arm, shoulder, back, neck or jaw, sweating, nausea or shortness of breath. Symptoms can be different in different people. Seek emergency medical care immediately if a heart attack is suspected. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Okulumbibwa kw'omutima mbeera ya bwangu. Obubonero buyinza okuba obulumi oba okukakana mu kifuba, obulumi okusaasaana mu mukono, mugongo, bulago oba kabina, okutukuta, okusesema oba okussa obubi. Singa okiteebereza, genda mangu mu ddwaliro. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Kidney disease can develop silently and is more common in people with diabetes or high blood pressure. Warning signs can include swelling, changes in urination, persistent tiredness, nausea or itching, but symptoms may be absent early. Blood and urine tests can help assess kidney function. Seek urgent care for severe swelling, very little urine, confusion or severe breathing difficulty. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Endwadde z'ensigo ziyinza okutambula nga tewali bubonero, naddala ku balina diabetes oba omusaayi ogw'amaanyi. Obubonero buyinza okuba amagulu okuvimba, okukyuka mu musulo, okukoowa n'okusesema. Okwekebejja omusaayi n'omusulo kuyamba okumanya ensigo bwe zikola. Okussa obubi nnyo oba omusulo okukendeera ennyo byetaaga obujjanjabi. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Liver disease has many causes, including viral hepatitis, alcohol-related injury, medicines and metabolic conditions. Symptoms may include tiredness, abdominal swelling or pain, yellow eyes or skin, dark urine or easy bleeding. Persistent or severe symptoms need medical assessment. Avoid unnecessary medicines and excess alcohol and do not share medicines with others. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Endwadde z'ekibumba zirina ensonga nnyingi, nga hepatitis, omwenge omungi, eddagala oba endwadde z'omubiri. Obubonero buyinza okuba obukoowu, olubuto okuvimba, amaaso okuba agavvu, omusulo okuba omuddugavu oba okusaasaana omusaayi. Singa obubonero bumala, genda ku musawo. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Cancer includes many different diseases and early detection can improve treatment options. Warning signs that persist include an unexplained lump, unusual bleeding, unexplained weight loss, persistent cough, changes in bowel habits or a sore that does not heal. These signs do not automatically mean cancer, but they should be assessed by a health worker. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Kkansa mulimu endwadde nnyingi ez'enjawulo, era okukwatibwa nga bukyali kuyinza okuyamba obujjanjabi. Ekizimba ekitaggwa, omusaayi ogutategerekeka, obuzito okukendeera, okukolola okumala, okukyuka mu kugenda mu kaabuyonjo oba ekiwundu ekitawona birina okwekebejjebwa. Obubonero buno tebutegeeza nti ddala kkansa, naye buwetaaga omusawo. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Diabetes can occur during pregnancy and may have no obvious symptoms. Antenatal care includes screening and monitoring when indicated. Keeping blood sugar controlled helps protect both mother and baby. Follow the treatment and diet advice given by the maternity team. Seek urgent care for severe vomiting, confusion, severe weakness, breathing difficulty or reduced fetal movement. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Sukaali omungi mu musaayi asobola okubaawo mu lubuto nga tewali bubonero bweyoleka. Mu ANC, abasawo basobola okukebera sukaali nga kyetaagisa. Goberera obulagirizi bw'abasawo ku mmere n'obujjanjabi. Omwana bw'alekera awo okutambula oba maama n'aba n'obuzibu mu kussa, genda mangu mu ddwaliro. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: A newborn needs urgent assessment if they cannot breastfeed or feed, have difficulty breathing, fever or feel unusually cold, have repeated convulsions, become very sleepy or unresponsive, develop severe jaundice, or have other sudden deterioration. Keep the baby warm and seek care promptly. Do not delay because newborn infections can become severe quickly. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Omwana omuto alina okugenda mangu ku ddwaliro singa tasobola kuyonsa, akussa obubi, alina omusujja oba abeera mukalu nnyo, akwatibwa ensimbu, abeera mugonvu nnyo oba atalaba, oba amaaso n'olususu bifuuka byenvu nnyo. Mumukuumire nga wa bugumu era mugende mangu ku ddwaliro. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

label_lg: Obutaba na Mm食a Amala mu Mwana
answer_en: Child malnutrition can affect growth, immunity and development. Warning signs include marked thinness, swelling of both feet, poor appetite, weakness or failure to grow. Children should have growth monitored using the child health card and should receive appropriate nutritious food. A child who is very weak, unable to drink or breastfeed, has repeated vomiting or is becoming less responsive needs urgent care. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Obutaba na mmere emala mu mwana buyinza okukosa okukula, obusobozi bw'omubiri okulwanyisa endwadde n'okukula kw'obwongo. Obubonero mulimu okunafuwa ennyo, amagulu gombi okuvimba, obutayagala kulya oba obuzito obutakula. Omwana alina okwekebejjebwa ku kaadi y'obulamu. Singa tasobola kunywa oba ayonsa, genda mangu mu ddwaliro. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Breast milk provides important nutrition and protection for babies. Exclusive breastfeeding is recommended for the first six months when possible, followed by appropriate complementary foods while breastfeeding continues. A baby who is not feeding well, has fewer wet diapers than usual, is very sleepy or has breathing difficulty should be assessed promptly. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Amata ga maama gawa omwana emmere n'obukuumi obukulu. Nga kisoboka, omwana ayonsibwa yekka mu myezi mukaaga egisooka, oluvannyuma ne hateekebwawo emmere eyongerwako ng'okuyonsa kugenda mu maaso. Omwana atayonka bulungi, atali mumativu oba akussa obubi alina okwekebejjebwa mangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: A healthy diet should include a variety of vegetables, fruits, whole or minimally processed staple foods, protein sources and healthy fats, with safe water. Limit excess salt, added sugar and highly processed foods. Children, pregnant women, older adults and people with medical conditions may have different nutrition needs and should seek individualized advice when needed. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Endya enungi erina okuba n'enva endiirwa, ebibala, emmere ezimba omubiri, protein n'amasavu amalungi, wamu n'amazzi amayonjo. Kendeeza omunnyo mungi, sukaali omungi n'emmere ezikolebwa ennyo. Abana, abakyala abali embuto n'abantu abalina endwadde bayinza okwetaaga obulagirizi obw'enjawulo. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Dehydration happens when the body loses more fluid than it takes in. It can occur with diarrhea, vomiting, fever, heavy sweating or poor fluid intake. Give appropriate fluids and oral rehydration solution when indicated. Severe dehydration can cause confusion, extreme weakness, very little urine, fainting or shock and requires urgent medical care. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Okukala amazzi mu mubiri kubaawo ng'omubiri gufiirwa amazzi mangi okusinga ge gukola. Kiyinza okuva ku kutabaala, okusesema, omusujja oba okutukuta ennyo. Nywa amazzi oba ORS nga bwe kisaanira. Okutabulwa, obunafu obw'amaanyi, omusulo omutono nnyo oba okuzirika byetaaga obujjanjabi obw'amangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: For a fresh minor burn, cool the area with clean running water for about 20 minutes and remove nearby jewellery or tight clothing if it is not stuck to the skin. Do not apply toothpaste, butter, oil or other household substances. Cover loosely with a clean non-stick dressing. Large, deep, electrical, chemical or facial burns need urgent medical care. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Ku kwokebwa okutono okupya, funya amazzi amayonjo agakulukuta ku kifo ekyo okumala eddakiika nga amakumi abiri. Ggyamu empeta oba ebintu ebinyweza singa tebikwatidde ku lususu. Tokozesa toothpaste, mafuta oba butto ku kiwundu. Okwokebwa okunene, okw'amaanyi, okw'amasannyalaze, okw'eddagala oba okw'amaaso kwetaaga ddwaliro mangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: A snakebite can be life-threatening. Keep the person calm and as still as possible and take them to a health facility urgently. Do not cut the bite, suck out venom, apply a tight tourniquet, burn the wound or try to catch the snake. If safe, a photo taken from a distance may help identification, but do not risk another bite. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Okulumwa enzoka kuyinza okuba okw'obulabe. Mutendereze omuntu era mumukuumire nga tatambula nnyo, mumutwale mangu mu ddwaliro. Temusalako kiwundu, temunywa butwa, temukwata ekintu ekinyweza ennyo ku mukono oba kugoba butwa nga mubya. Temukwata nzoka. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Rabies is a deadly infection that can be prevented after an exposure if care is started promptly. After a bite or scratch from a potentially infected animal, wash the wound thoroughly with soap and running water and seek urgent medical assessment. Do not wait for symptoms. Rabies prevention may include vaccination and, for some exposures, additional treatment. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Rabies ndwadde ya bulabe nnyo naye eyinza okuziyizibwa singa obujjanjabi butandika mangu ng'omuntu alumiddwa oba akubiddwa ekisolo. Naaba ekiwundu n'omusaaba n'amazzi agakulukuta era genda mangu ku ddwaliro. Tolinda bubonero kutandika. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Meningitis can be caused by infections and may become life-threatening quickly. Possible signs include severe headache, fever, stiff neck, vomiting, confusion, seizures, sensitivity to light or a rash. In babies there may be poor feeding, unusual sleepiness or a bulging soft spot. Suspected meningitis needs emergency medical care. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Meningitis eyinza okuva ku buwuka era eyinza okuba ey'obulabe amangu. Obubonero buyinza okuba omutwe ogw'amaanyi, omusujja, ensingo okukakanyala, okusesema, okutabulwa, ensimbu oba okwetya ekitangaala. Genda mangu mu ddwaliro singa obubonero buno bulabika. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Measles is a highly contagious viral infection that can cause fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes and a spreading rash. Vaccination is the main prevention. A child with suspected measles should be assessed by a health worker and kept away from vulnerable people while following local infection-control advice. Difficulty breathing, severe weakness, dehydration or confusion requires urgent care. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Masii ndwadde ya virus esaasaana mangu. Eyinza okuleeta omusujja, okukolola, amazzi mu nnyindo, amaaso ammyufu n'amabwa agasaasaana. Obugema bwe bukulu mu kuziyiza. Omwana ayinza okuba ne masii alina okwekebejjebwa era akuumibwe wala n'abantu abalala nga bwe balagirwa. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Dengue is a viral infection spread by infected mosquitoes. It can cause high fever, severe headache, body aches, nausea and rash. Warning signs of severe disease include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, extreme weakness, restlessness or difficulty breathing. Seek medical care urgently if these occur. Avoid self-medicating with medicines that increase bleeding risk unless a clinician advises them. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Dengue ndwadde ya virus etambulira mu nsiri. Eyinza okuleeta omusujja omungi, omutwe ogw'amaanyi, obulumi mu mubiri, okusesema n'amabwa. Obulumi obw'amaanyi mu lubuto, okusesema okutaggwa, omusaayi oba okussa obubi byetaaga ddwaliro mangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Reduce diarrheal disease by drinking safe treated water, washing hands with soap after using the toilet and before preparing or eating food, using sanitation facilities, and keeping food protected. During outbreaks, follow local public-health instructions and seek care early for watery diarrhea. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Kendeeza endwadde z'okutabaala ng'onywa amazzi amayonjo agalamiddwa, onaaba engalo n'omusaaba ng'ovudde mu kaabuyonjo ne nga tonnategeka oba okulya emmere, era okozesa kaabuyonjo bulungi. Mu kiseera ky'endwadde, goberera obubaka bw'abasawo n'ogende mangu ku ddwaliro singa otandika okutabaala okw'amazzi. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Family planning methods include condoms, pills, injectables, implants, intrauterine devices and permanent methods. Different methods suit different people and have different benefits, side effects and medical considerations. A health worker can help you choose a method based on your needs. Condoms also help reduce HIV and other STI transmission. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Enkola z'okuteekateeka okuzaala mulimu kondomu, obupil, empiso, implants, IUD n'enkola ez'olubeerera. Enkola esaanira omuntu omu eyinza obutasaana omulala. Buulira omusawo ku by'oyagala n'akuyambe okulonda enkola esaanira. Kondomu era ziyamba okukendeeza HIV n'endwadde ez'obukaba. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: The weeks after birth are important for both mother and baby. Mothers need follow-up for bleeding, blood pressure, infection, breastfeeding and emotional wellbeing. Urgent warning signs include heavy bleeding, severe headache, fever, severe abdominal pain, difficulty breathing, seizures or thoughts of self-harm. The baby also needs timely newborn and immunization care. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Wiiki ez'oluvannyuma lw'okuzaala nkulu eri maama n'omwana. Maama alina okukeberebwa ku musaayi, pressure, ndwadde, okuyonsa n'embeera y'obwongo. Omusaayi mungi, omutwe ogw'amaanyi, omusujja, okussa obubi oba ensimbu byetaaga ddwaliro mangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Menstruation is a normal body process. Period pain can be common, but severe or new pain should be assessed. Very heavy bleeding, bleeding between periods, bleeding after sex, fainting or symptoms of anemia need medical review. Track your cycle if symptoms are difficult to describe, and seek advice about safe pain relief if needed. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Emikolo nkola ya bulijjo ey'omubiri. Obulumi obutono buyinza okuba obwa bulijjo, naye obulumi obw'amaanyi oba obupya bulina okwekebejjebwa. Omusaayi mungi nnyo, omusaayi wakati w'emikolo, okuzirika oba obunafu byetaaga omusawo. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Sexual health includes prevention of infections, contraception, consent and management of sexual problems. Condoms reduce the risk of HIV and many STIs when used correctly. Seek confidential care for pain, sores, discharge, bleeding, erectile problems or other concerns. Do not take antibiotics or sexual medicines without appropriate professional advice. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Obulamu bw'obwegassi bukwata ku kuziyiza endwadde, okuzaala, okukkiriza n'ebizibu ebikwata ku kwegatta. Kondomu ziyamba okukendeeza HIV n'endwadde ez'obukaba. Genda ku musawo nga waliwo obulumi, amabwa, amazzi agava mu bitundu by'ekyama oba ekizibu ekirala. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Allergies can cause itching, hives, sneezing, watery eyes or swelling after exposure to a trigger. Severe allergic reactions can cause swelling of the lips or tongue, difficulty breathing, fainting or sudden weakness and are emergencies. Avoid known triggers and seek medical advice for recurrent reactions. Do not assume every rash is an allergy. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Allergy eyinza okuleeta okwekuba, amabwa, okukwasa, amazzi mu maaso oba okuvimba oluvannyuma lw'okukwatibwa ekintu ekikuleetera allergy. Singa emimwa oba olulimi bivimba, okussa kuba kuzibu oba omuntu azirika, genda mangu mu ddwaliro. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Headaches have many possible causes, including dehydration, infections, stress, migraine and other conditions. Rest, fluids and identifying triggers may help some mild headaches. A sudden severe headache, headache with weakness, confusion, seizures, fever and stiff neck, head injury or vision loss requires urgent medical assessment. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Omutwe guyinza okuluma olw'okukala amazzi mu mubiri, endwadde, stress, migraine oba ensonga endala. Okwewummuza n'okunywa amazzi biyinza okuyamba ku mutwe ogutali gwa maanyi. Omutwe ogw'amangu ogw'amaanyi ennyo, nga guli n'ensimbu, okutabulwa, omusujja, ensingo okukakanyala oba okutalaba, gwetaaga ddwaliro mangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Back pain is common and can result from muscle strain, posture or other conditions. Gentle activity and avoiding prolonged bed rest may help many uncomplicated cases. Seek urgent care for new loss of bladder or bowel control, numbness around the groin, severe weakness in the legs, fever, major injury or severe worsening pain. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Obulumi bw'omugongo busobola okuva ku misitula, engeri gy'otambulamu oba ensonga endala. Okutambula mpola n'okwewala okulala okumala ebbanga ddene biyamba abantu bangi. Obutafuga musulo oba kasooli, amagulu okunafuwa ennyo, omusujja oba okukosebwa okunene byetaaga ddwaliro mangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Fever is a sign that the body may be responding to an infection or another problem. In Uganda, malaria should be considered when fever occurs and testing is important where available. Give appropriate fluids and monitor the person. Urgent care is needed for confusion, seizures, difficulty breathing, severe weakness, persistent vomiting, severe dehydration or a very unwell young child. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Omusujja kabonero nti omubiri guyinza okuba gulwanyisa ndwadde oba buzibu obulala. Mu Uganda, malaria erina okulowoozebwako omuntu bw'aba n'omusujja era okwekebeza kikulu nga kisoboka. Wa amazzi agamala era goberera embeera. Okutabulwa, ensimbu, okussa obubi oba okusesema ennyo byetaaga ddwaliro. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Cough can be caused by infections, asthma, allergies, reflux or other conditions. A cough lasting two weeks or more should be assessed, especially with weight loss, fever, night sweats or coughing blood because TB and other illnesses may need testing. Difficulty breathing, chest pain, blue lips or severe weakness requires urgent care. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Okukolola kuyinza okuva ku ndwadde, asima, allergy, mubisi gw'olubuto oba ensonga endala. Okukolola okumala wiiki bbiri oba okusingawo kulina okwekebejjebwa, naddala nga waliwo okukendeera obuzito, omusujja, okutukuta ekiro oba okukolola omusaayi. Okussa obubi oba obulumi mu kifuba byetaaga ddwaliro mangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Ear pain can result from infection, wax, injury or other problems. Do not insert sticks, pins or other objects into the ear. Persistent pain, discharge, hearing loss, swelling behind the ear, severe dizziness or fever should be assessed. Sudden major hearing loss needs prompt medical evaluation. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Okuluma kw'amatwi kuyinza okuva ku buwuka, wax, okukosebwa oba ensonga endala. Tossa busonge, mpiso oba kintu kyonna mu kutu. Obulumi obutawera, amazzi okuva mu kutu, okuwulira okukendeera, okuvimba emabega w'ekutu oba omusujja byetaaga omusawo. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Food poisoning can cause vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal cramps and fever after contaminated food or water. The main concern is dehydration, so fluids and oral rehydration solution can be important. Seek urgent care for blood in stool or vomit, severe dehydration, confusion, persistent vomiting or severe abdominal pain. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Obutwa bw'emmere buyinza okuleeta okusesema, okutabaala, obulumi mu lubuto n'omusujja. Ekikulu kwe kuziyiza okukala amazzi mu mubiri, nga okunywa amazzi oba ORS. Omusaayi mu kasooli oba mu by'osesema, okutabulwa oba obulumi obw'amaanyi mu lubuto byetaaga ddwaliro mangu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Suspected poisoning is an emergency when symptoms are severe or the substance may be dangerous. Move away from fumes if safe and seek emergency medical help. Do not make the person vomit unless a qualified professional specifically tells you to. Keep the container or name of the substance if it can be done safely. Do not give unknown substances as a home remedy. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Okunywa oba okukwatibwa obutwa kuyinza okuba okw'obulabe. Genda mangu ku ddwaliro oba funa obuyambi bw'amangu. Tokakasa muntu kusesema okuggyamu butwa okuggyako nga omukugu akulagidde. Singa kisoboka, twala erinnya oba ekibbo ky'ekintu ekyo. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Good hygiene reduces many infections. Wash hands with soap after using the toilet and before preparing or eating food. Keep drinking water safe, use sanitation facilities, keep food covered and maintain clean living spaces. Teach children handwashing and safe toilet habits from an early age. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Obuyonjo buyamba okuziyiza endwadde nnyingi. Naaba engalo n'omusaaba ng'ovudde mu kaabuyonjo ne nga tonnategeka oba okulya emmere. Kuuma amazzi nga mayonjo, kozesa kaabuyonjo era kuuma awaka nga wonjo. Yigiriza abaana okukola obuyonjo. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Tobacco smoking damages the lungs, heart and blood vessels and increases the risk of cancer. Second-hand smoke can also harm other people, including children. Quitting is beneficial at any age. If you want to stop, a health worker can help you make a quit plan and manage cravings and withdrawal. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Okunywa taaba kwonoona amawuggwe, omutima n'emisuwa era kwongera obulabe bwa kkansa. Omukka gw'omuntu anywa taaba gukosa n'abali okumpi, naddala abaana. Okuleka taaba kiyamba ku myaka gyonna. Buulira omusawo akuyambe enteekateeka y'okugireka. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: Heavy or harmful alcohol use can damage the liver, heart, brain and relationships and can increase injuries and other health risks. If you drink, reducing intake lowers risk; some people should avoid alcohol completely, including during pregnancy and with certain medicines or conditions. If stopping suddenly may cause withdrawal, seek medical advice rather than trying to manage severe withdrawal alone. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Okunywa omwenge mungi kuyinza okwonoona ekibumba, omutima n'obwongo era kwongera obulabe bw'okufuna obubenje. Okukendeeza ku mwenge kukendeeza obulabe. Abakyala abali embuto n'abantu abalina embeera ezimu balina okwewala omwenge. Omuntu anywa ennyo era ayagala okulekera ddala alina okufuna obuyambi bw'omukugu. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.

answer_en: If you need care, use an authorized health facility or ask your local Village Health Team member where to go. For emergencies, go to the nearest facility capable of providing urgent care or contact your local emergency services. Take any medicines, health cards and relevant medical information if available. This information is for general education and does not replace examination or diagnosis by a qualified health worker.
answer_lg: Bw'oba weetaaga obujjanjabi, genda ku ddwaliro oba ekifo ky'obujjanjabi ekikkirizibwa, oba buuza omukozi wa Village Health Team ali okumpi naawe. Mu mbeera y'amangu, genda ku ddwaliro erisobola okuwa obuyambi obw'amangu. Twala kaadi y'obulamu n'eddagala ly'onywa nga kisoboka. Obubaka buno bwa kuyiga ku bulamu era tebukola ng'obujjanjabi oba okwekebejjebwa omusawo.
